0022600200.text: The Boston Celtics, 7-2 and second in the East, visit the Milwaukee Bucks for their 10th game of the 2026-27 season, riding a two-game winning streak. Milwaukee is 1-8 and 15th in the East, and it has lost five straight. Boston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 109-102 win in Boston on November 4, and the Celtics won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
